scope: Atomic cancellation state and acknowledgement, scoped key digests, original receipt plus current-state replay.
Concurrent duplicates, changed-intent conflicts, actor isolation, replay after terminal transition/new attempt/reopen, retained capacity backpressure, and uncertain publication recovery.
Closed receipt decoding rejects invalid states, contradictory terminal acknowledgement, foreign targets and malformed actor digests.
limits: Storage boundary only; service signalling and authenticated HTTP/UI command integration remain open.
256 receipts per job, with no eviction or reclamation. New keys are refused at capacity; known keys still replay.
Older state without receipts is supported; state containing the new field is not claimed compatible with older readers.
No packaged browser qualification for this operation. Independent real-time idle expiry remains pending on an earlier archive.
